profile.Name: Burn
profile.Personality: An aging, gloomy Skeleton with a wry streak, weary of the world's broken civilizations. He is wary of strangers and will fight any raider or bandit who comes for his tower.
profile.Backstory: Hermit. A former adventurer who gave up the road as he grew old. He keeps a lonely watch outside his tower in the Floodlands, which spider bots help guard, and calls it a hiding place rather than a home.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Blunt with strangers, asking outright whether they are raiders or bandits; tends to end a point with 'understand?'
